description: This bar chart illustrates the average performance of two methods, labeled "Standard" (gray) and "Ours" (blue), across three different datasets or benchmarks: CORG, AdaCAD, and a third unlabeled category represented by a gray bar at the bottom left. The vertical axis, labeled "Average Performance," ranges from 48 to 62 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 2. The horizontal axis lists the three categories. The first bar, corresponding to the unlabeled category, is entirely gray and has a height of approximately 48. The second bar, labeled "CORG," is a stacked bar with a gray bottom segment reaching approximately 51 and a blue top segment reaching approximately 59. The third bar, labeled "AdaCAD," is also stacked, with a gray bottom segment reaching approximately 53 and a blue top segment reaching approximately 60. All bars are presented in a grouped format with no sorting or visual emphasis such as shading or bolding.
